name: dumbbell powell raise
description: A side-lying raise that targets the rear shoulder with a long range of motion.
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with the arm hanging in front of your body.
Raise the arm out and back in an arc until it is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Use a light weight and switch sides after your set.
